title: puebloa bradyi
intro: Puebloa bradyi, commonly known as desert marigold, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as its antiseptic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory effects, helping to soothe wounds and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of Puebloa bradyi include its ability to promote tissue repair, reduce fever, and calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and other alkaloids that contribute to its medicinal properties.
